overall_summary: Husband-wife relationship dynamics significantly outperform all other categories, driving over 1,600+ views per video, whereas abstract poetic Shayari and generic family topics struggle to gain traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात...' (1,679 views) are the top 2 performing videos on the channel by a massive margin.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on subtle, realistic post-marriage emotional micro-moments.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on specific relational friction (e.g. husband/wife communication or acknowledging apologies) get higher engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Frame hooks around quiet, unsaid marital feelings rather than generic preachy advice.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic poetic lines; replace with concrete real-life scenarios.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister-focused videos recorded very low views (19 views and 139 views across two attempts).
weak_patterns.action: Pause generic sibling appreciation posts until core audience is firmly established.
